Scrap-Rat Swarm.name: Scrap-Rat Swarm
Scrap-Rat Swarm.text: Dozens of scavenged-metal rats, fused together by rot. Attacks with DEX. On defeat: swarm scatters, leaves a working component behind.

The Static Warden.name: The Static Warden
The Static Warden.text: What's left of the mall's old security system, grown into something else. Attacks with INT. On defeat: the signal core is yours.
